title: FBI-UAP-D002, FD-1057, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-1057 forensic sketch interview record regarding a UAP sighting near Cheyenne Mountain.

incidents.summary: A former U.S. Army intelligence officer and four unit members observed a UAP over the Cheyenne Mountains.
incidents.quote: The object was potato shaped with distinct edges and appeared to look painted in a creamy/whitish opalescent color.
